Unlikely; Gyarados is happy to pressure a lead Crawdaunt. (3) THEIR READ OF ME: they expect Crawdaunt to Knock Off / Crabhammer / Aqua Jet; they know Crawdaunt is slow (base 55) and may expect me to switch out to a Gyarados answer (they've seen none). (5) MOST LIKELY ACTION: Gyarados DDs (or Power Whips). Best reply = Knock Off, which OHKOs through the item boost if it DDs, or at worst removes Leftovers and chunks it. Falsifier: if it DDs and survives Knock Off at >25%, or if it reveals Power Whip and kills Crawdaunt for free. (6) SEQUENCE: Crawdaunt Knock Off → if Gyarados DDs it likely faints (huge win); if Gyarados attacks, Gyarados is left 17-30% (item gone) and Crawdaunt (25-78% HP) faces a +boosted or plain Gyarados next turn — I then likely lose Crawdaunt but it already did its job.
